high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website "science.thewire.in," as indicated by the URL at the top of the screen. The time displayed on the phone's status bar is 1:22, and the battery level is at 14%. The article discusses a study conducted by Nitika, who investigated whether each wasp has a favorite place to sit on the nest. The text in the article states that Nitika was skeptical about the idea but found that wasps do indeed have preferred locations on their nests. To gather data, Nitika video-recorded several wasp colonies and manually extracted the spatial locations
